title: Customer Care Agent
description_text:
Join the Island's Leading Transport Industry Company as a Customer Care Agent! 🚗🔧Are you a highly skilled and experienced Customer Care Agent eager for a fulfilling career opportunity? Your search ends here! Join our esteemed client, one of the island's largest and most prestigious companies. 🌴This is an exceptional chance to become a vital member of a diverse and dynamic team. Our client is actively seeking a Customer Care Agent to join their Commercial Department. Join this motivated team as we work together to attain excellence. 
 Main Responsibilities include but are not limited to: 
 Answering calls - Responding to customer queries.
 Replying to customers’ messages via Facebook, Web, Emails.
 Dealing with complaints in a courteous and professional manner.
 Any other ad hoc customer care related work.
 Requirements: 
 Strong communication skills, both written and verbal - Maltese and English.
 Microsoft Office Package; MS Excel and MS Word.
 O level standard of education.
 Positive attitude.
 Flexibility to work shifts and willingness to learn.
 Ability to work as part of a team / unsupervised at times.
 Ability to work accurately, with attention to detail.
 Problem solving skills.
 Ability to think outside the box and go the exta mile for the customer.
 Apply now to seize this exceptional opportunity!
